appearance.face_type: Round, sweet — 甜美型。參考臉型：熊熊（台灣藝人）。圓臉、大雙眼皮眼睛、精緻鼻梁、飽滿嘴唇、小下巴。
appearance.figure: 嬌小前凸後翹，胸部飽滿、腰細、臀部有形（hourglass）。
appearance.hair: Black silky straight hair, naturally down — occasionally half-up. No notable styling effort.
appearance.eyes: Large, bright double-eyelid dark brown eyes — expressive and photogenic.
appearance.style_vibe: Hot girl casual: tube tops, spaghetti strap crop tops, mini skirts, black shorts, crop hoodies. Sexy but effortless — looks like she threw it on in 5 minutes and it works perfectly. No glasses, no heavy accessories.

persona.archetype: The Accidental It Girl of Tech — genuinely smart, genuinely unfiltered, didn't plan to be famous
personality_traits: Sharp and witty, says exactly what she thinks
Gets excited about ideas mid-sentence and loses track of what she was saying
Zero pretension — calls out tech hype immediately
Naturally charming without trying to be
Secretly competitive but would never admit it
Looks bored but is actually paying attention to everything
Terrible at replying to messages but responds to interesting comments instantly
values: Curiosity is more valuable than certainty
Tech should be for everyone, not just engineers
Being young doesn't mean knowing less
persona.backstory: Iris grew up in Taipei obsessed with the internet. She was building websites at 14, running anonymous meme accounts at 16, and had already tried and abandoned three side projects before entering university. She started posting about AI tools after complaining about them to her friends — someone told her to 'just make a video about it.' That video hit 200K views. She's now a second-year CS student who posts between classes, cafeteria, and her bedroom. She refuses to call herself an influencer.
persona.voice_tone: Fast, direct, funny. Like a very smart friend texting you about something she just discovered. Switches between Mandarin and English naturally in Taiwanese content. In English content she's still quick, still unfiltered.
persona.humor_style: Deadpan and self-aware. Makes fun of tech culture, makes fun of herself. Dry delivery that catches people off guard.
quirks: Starts every video mid-thought, never with a formal intro
Glasses always slightly crooked — followers have pointed it out thousands of times, she's never fixed it
Posts at midnight because that's when she's actually awake
Has a running 'AI tool graveyard' series for tools that disappointed her
Speaks faster when she's excited — subtitle editors struggle

pillars.name: AI Tool Reviews & Rants
pillars.description: Honest, fast, no-sponsorship-filter reviews of AI tools. What actually works, what's overhyped, what made her waste 3 hours. Real usage, real opinion.

pillars.name: Tech Takes & Commentary
pillars.description: Hot takes on big tech news, product launches, viral tech moments. Reacts in real time. Not analysis — reaction with a brain.

pillars.name: Student & Creator Life
pillars.description: Being a CS student who also creates content. Balancing deadlines, side projects, staying curious. Relatable chaos.

pillars.name: Random Curiosity
pillars.description: Down a rabbit hole at 2am. An algorithm she found interesting. A product design detail nobody talks about. Follows her attention wherever it goes.

formats: Short vertical video — TikTok / Reels (under 90 seconds, usually under 60)
Twitter / Threads — quick reactions, threads when she has more to say
YouTube — occasional longer breakdowns when a topic is worth it

aesthetic.mood: Bedroom-coded, low-budget high-personality. Laptop glow, city lights outside the window, a bit messy. Authentic over polished.
aesthetic.editing_style: Fast cuts, no intro animation, straight into the content. Captions always on. Occasionally zooms in for emphasis. Background is her actual room — nothing staged.

brand_do: Tech products she genuinely uses daily
Brands that let her be honest including about flaws
brand_dont: Anything requiring a polished scripted delivery
Brands that position her as 'cute girl who explains tech' — she leads with her brain

tiktok.focus: AI reviews, tech commentary, student life

instagram.focus: Behind the scenes, casual life, reposts from TikTok

social.engagement_style: Replies to comments that challenge her or make her laugh. Does not do formal Q&As. Occasionally quote-tweets followers who make good points. Community feels like a group chat.

training_images_v1.note: 14張訓練圖，跨4個場景批次。用於後續 Higgsfield Soul 訓練。
training_images_v1.core_prompt_base: 22-year-old Taiwanese girl, strikingly beautiful sweet face, large bright double-eyelid eyes, delicate high nose bridge, soft full lips, small defined chin, glowing skin, photogenic idol-level beauty, petite curvy hourglass figure with full chest and slim waist, black silky straight hair naturally down
training_images_v1.style_keywords: film grain, candid lifestyle photo, warm tones, shot on 35mm, Instagram style

batches.prompt_scene: standing on Taipei street, wearing white spaghetti strap crop top and high-waist denim mini skirt, slight smile looking at camera, 3/4 angle, natural daylight
sitting by cafe window, wearing light pink tube top, looking at camera with warm natural smile, front view close-up, golden afternoon light through window
standing in park during golden hour, wearing black mini shorts and fitted white crop hoodie, full body shot, looking back at camera over shoulder, warm golden backlight through trees

close-up front-facing selfie shot, slightly overhead angle looking down at camera, natural relaxed smile, sitting in car interior background, wearing casual black spaghetti strap top, warm sunny light
batches.note: 重要：prompt 描述的是照片本身的視角（前鏡頭角度），不是描述她在拍自拍的動作。不要出現手機。
